`null_resource.update_trust_policy` lists `aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution` in its `depends_on`, but the local-exec command already interpolates `${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}`, an ordinary attribute reference that establishes the same dependency. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

`aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng` lists `aws_iam_role.managed_ng` in its `depends_on`, but `node_role_arn = ... aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn` already references that role, producing the same implicit dependency. The explicit depends_on entry for the role is redundant (the instance-profile and policy-attachment entries are not referenced and are legitimately needed).

`null_resource.update_trust_policy` lists `kubernetes_namespace.spark` in its `depends_on`, but the local-exec command already interpolates `${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}`, which is an ordinary attribute reference that Terraform turns into the same ordering edge. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.
